name: blaym-jupyter-types
description: Shared Blaym Jupyter contracts and protocol types

scripts.schema:check: tmp=$(mktemp) && ts-json-schema-generator --path src/contracts.ts --type BlaymEventEnvelope --tsconfig tsconfig.json --no-top-ref -o "$tmp" && diff -u schema/blaym-event-envelope.schema.json "$tmp"; rc=$?; rm -f "$tmp"; exit $rc
